description.en: Adds a Skills page to the sidebar with two tabs: Installed lists the skills installed globally for every DSH session and uninstalls each one the right way (through npx skills, or by deleting a manually installed directory); Saved keeps a personal list of npx skills sources (owner/repo, GitHub/GitLab links, any git URL, absolute local paths, and package names — packages can be saved but not expanded) entered through a Save dialog opened from the button next to Refresh, opens a repo from its title when the source has a web address, deletes entries with a delete button styled like the uninstall action, probes each listable saved source (GitHub, any git remote, or a local path) and labels it as an npx skills repository, a Claude Code marketplace, or unavailable, and expands the usable ones into a cached skills tree grouped by plugin for marketplaces, and installs any single skill from that tree into the global skills directory with one click (through npx skills add -g; an already-installed skill shows an installed mark instead); git remotes are shallow-cloned into a cache under the DSH home and local paths are scanned in place, and it exposes the saved repositories, their skills and marketplace plugins to other plugins through the ctx.bukaSkills Host service.
description.zh-cn: 在侧边栏新增「Skills」页面，顶部两个 Tab：已安装列出对所有会话生效的全局 skills，并按来源选择正确的卸载方式（交给 npx skills，或直接删除手工安装的目录）；收藏用来记下常用的 npx skills 来源（owner/repo、GitHub/GitLab 链接、任意 git 地址、本地绝对路径、包名；包名可收藏但不能展开），点「刷新」旁边的「收藏」按钮在对话框里填写仓库与备注，有网页地址的来源点标题打开仓库、可删除收藏；每个可列出的来源都会自动判定是 npx skills 仓库、Claude Code marketplace 仓库还是不可用并显示徽标，可用仓库还能展开成带缓存的 skills 树（marketplace 按插件分组），树里每个 skill 都能一键安装到全局（交给 npx skills add -g，已经装好的显示「已安装」），git 地址先浅克隆到 DSH home 缓存、本地路径直接扫描；同时通过 ctx.bukaSkills Host 服务把收藏仓库、仓库里的 skills 与 marketplace 插件列表开放给其他插件。
